title: Pure Cupid
summary: Cupid Level-modulation Synchro build combining all five Cupid monsters (Pitch, Fore, Dunk, Serve, and Volley) with Diviner of the Herald and The Agent engine (Venus, Earth, and Neptune). Cupid Pitch searches any 600 DEF monster when used as Synchro Material, while Cupid Fore copies high Levels onto Cupid Dunk and Cupid Serve to create untouchable towers and Level 7 to 11 Synchros.

summary.title: Starters
points: Diviner of the Herald is a one-card starter (also searchable via Piri Reis Map) that sends Trias Hierarchia or Elder Entity N'tss from the Deck or Extra Deck to the GY to modulate its Level, pop a card, or Tribute itself to summon a Level 2 or lower Fairy (Cupid Serve, Cupid Volley, or The Agent of Mystery - Earth) from the Deck.
The Agent of Creation - Venus pays 500 LP per activation to Special Summon up to 3 copies of Mystical Shine Ball from the hand or Deck, generating instant Synchro and Rank 2 Xyz materials.
The Agent of Mystery - Earth searches Venus (or The Agent of Life - Neptune) on Normal Summon and serves as a Level 2 LIGHT Fairy Tuner.

summary.title: Opening: Diviner of the Herald / Agent Venus into Cupid Pitch
steps: Normal Summon Diviner of the Herald, send Trias Hierarchia from the Deck to the GY, and Tribute Diviner from the GY to Special Summon Trias, triggering Diviner to summon The Agent of Mystery - Earth or Cupid Serve from the Deck (or open with Venus and a Tuner to summon 3 Mystical Shine Balls).
Synchro Summon Celestial Double Star Shaman (Level 2 Tuner) and Martial Metal Marcher (Level 3 Tuner) into Cupid Pitch (Level 4 Synchro Tuner), reviving Level 2s along the way.

Use Cupid Pitch and a non-Tuner to Synchro Summon F.A. Dawn Dragster, Draco Berserker of the Tenyi, Masterflare Hyperion, or Chaos Angel; Pitch searches a 600 DEF monster: Cupid Fore, Cupid Dunk, The Agent of Life - Neptune, or Hop Ear Squadron.

summary.title: Level Modulation & Towers
points: Cupid Fore Special Summons itself from the hand if all monsters you control are 600 DEF, and discards 1 card as a Quick Effect to make one LIGHT Fairy's Level match another face-up monster on the field (such as a Level 10 Synchro or Level 11 Diviner).

Cupid Dunk cannot be destroyed by battle with a monster of equal or lower Level and gains 300 ATK times its Level during each Standby Phase, while Cupid Serve is unaffected by activated effects of monsters whose Level/Rank is lower than or equal to Serve's Level (and banishes up to 3 cards from your GY to boost its Level and trigger Swordsoul Supreme Sovereign - Chengying).
Cupid Volley mills up to 3 cards from the top of the Deck to boost its Level up to Level 4, and gains 1500 LP if destroyed by the opponent.

summary.title: Bosses & Disruption
points: Chaos Angel (made with all LIGHT Fairies) banishes a card on summon and makes all Synchro Monsters you control unaffected by monster effects activated by your opponent, while Psychic End Punisher becomes unaffected by opponent's activated effects after Venus pays LP.

Hop Ear Squadron (600 DEF, searchable off Cupid Pitch) Special Summons itself as a Quick Effect during the opponent's Main Phase to immediately Synchro Summon with a Level-boosted Cupid monster or Level 2 body (such as Old Entity Hastorr).

The Agent of Life - Neptune (600 DEF, searchable off Pitch) discards itself to revive an Agent or Venus and grants Tribute immunity, and searches The Sanctuary in the Sky when banished by Cupid Serve.
